appDesc.message: Captions for web videos. Recognition and translation run in T-Translate on this computer.

pairHint.message: In T-Translate, open Settings → Audio → Listen and click Pair, then click Pair here within 60 seconds.

errProtocol.message: Channel version mismatch. Update T-Translate and the extension to the latest version.

errPairing.message: No T-Translate is waiting to pair. Click Pair in the app first, then click here within 60 seconds.

errUnreachable.message: Can't reach T-Translate. Make sure it is running and "Allow the browser extension to connect" is on.

errUnauthorized.message: The token is no longer valid. Pair again.
